integrity: The mixed law is derived by a direct bijection between a partition with a marked block of size r and a partition of the complementary labels. The sign monotonicity uses strict log-convexity of Bell numbers, and the threshold asymptotic uses a standard Bell-ratio estimate from the cited literature. Exact enumeration independently checks all finite identities through n=9.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns uniform set partitions and covariance with the total block count.
The exact finite sign threshold is defined through Bell ratios; only its asymptotic location is simplified to the Lambert-W scale.
Older multivariate Bell-generating-function literature may contain the same mixed moment implicitly.
title: Block-size counts switch covariance sign at the Lambert-W scale
